BLOCKING_GAPS.FACT: PRE_MISSION_FENCE_STOP closes Bootstrap work/mutation/integration gates but does not define an atomic or otherwise proven invalidation/freeze of already-existing legacy V11 mutation/integration authority.
BLOCKING_GAPS.WHY_BLOCKING: Before first Mission Fence, legacy actors may still possess authority not bound to V16 ENGINEERING_EPOCH/MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH. Merely closing V16 Bootstrap gates does not prove those legacy leases/claims cannot continue to authorize writes.

BLOCKING_GAPS.WHY_BLOCKING: A STOP global transition that omits mandatory transition identity is not a complete authoritative transition, and preempting an existing transition also requires an explicit representation of the preempted transition identity rather than silently overwriting or ambiguously retaining ACTIVE_TRANSITION fields.
